assessments.zone: Western and central Kitenge health zone (lon <= 25.85): Kenane/Budi, Kantonye, Kyabene/Kasenga, Mwine Ngoy, Fwila, Mpele, Kansele and surrounding villages
assessments.evidence: No reports of armed-group presence or attacks in the Kitenge health zone in 2025-2026; local reporting concerns health (cholera, Jan 2026), not insecurity. Mai-Mai activity in 2026 was in Bukama and Malemba-Nkulu. State police/administration assumed.

assessments.zone: Eastern Kitenge health zone villages nearer Malemba-Nkulu (lon > 25.85: Lubonge, Kiloba, Kayambi, Kima, Kibamba, Kamaungu, Makena, Besaba, Muloe, Mashasha, Kasongo, Kabukomo)
assessments.evidence: No reported armed-group activity, but these villages lie closest to Malemba-Nkulu territory where Mai-Mai/Bakata Katanga attacks resurged in 2026; state presence is thin and assumed.

assessments.zone: Rural Kabongo and Kayamba secteurs in Kabongo, Kayamba and Songa health zones (Kina/Kafwakumba, Kamungu, Twiteboya, Kambo, Kihumba, Lububu, Kayamba etc.)
assessments.evidence: No reported armed-group presence or attacks in western/central Kabongo territory in 2025-2026; the Mai-Mai violence that hit Kabongo in the mid-2000s has ended. State presence (police posts, customary chiefs, territorial administration) assumed.

assessments.zone: Eastern Kabongo territory, Kitenge health zone (Kitenge town 'Lualaba', Sohe, Mwadi Ngoy, Kamunza, Makwidi, Kashukulu, Kileo etc.)
assessments.evidence: No specific reports of armed-group activity in the Kitenge health zone in 2025-2026; it lies closer to Malemba-Nkulu territory, where Mai-Mai attacks resurged in 2026, so confidence is lower. Default state (PNC) presence assumed.

assessments.zone: Kabongo town (territory seat; GRID3 locality 'Nsele' incl. Kabongo 4, Commercial, Mukombozi etc.)
assessments.evidence: Territorial headquarters with state administration and police; no reports of armed-group activity in Kabongo in 2025-2026 while Mai-Mai attacks in Haut-Lomami were reported in Bukama and Malemba-Nkulu. Province described as calm in September 2026.

units.CD7304-kabongo-2: Part 2 of Kabongo territory covers the Kitenge health zone (eastern Kabongo territory, Haut-Lomami, west of the Lualaba). No armed-group control or attacks were reported in Kitenge in 2025-2026; the 2026 Mai-Mai/Bakata Katanga resurgence was reported in Bukama, Malemba-Nkulu (e.g. Kyamona) and Mitwaba, east and south of this zone. ACP described Haut-Lomami as calm in September 2026. All locations are assessed as default state presence under the PNC, with low-to-medium confidence given proximity to Malemba-Nkulu and the lack of local reporting.
units.CD7304-kabongo-1: Kabongo territory (Haut-Lomami) has no reported armed-group control or significant armed-group activity in 2025-2026; the Mai-Mai/Bakata Katanga resurgence in northern ex-Katanga in 2026 was concentrated in neighbouring Bukama, Malemba-Nkulu and Mitwaba. Historic Mai-Mai violence in Kabongo (Gédéon / 'Shinja Shinja' factions, mid-2000s) has long ended. ACP described Haut-Lomami as calm across the province in September 2026. Kabongo town (territory seat) and the rural secteurs Kabongo and Kayamba (Kabongo, Kitenge, Kayamba and Songa health zones) are assessed as default state presence under the PNC, with lower confidence for the eastern Kitenge health zone nearer Malemba-Nkulu.
